summary: Network (V4): an entity graph on SVG. Seeded force or radial layout, incremental — nodes already placed stay pinned while new ones are appended, and node.position fixes one — with the layout moved to a worker above workerThreshold (500 elements) and identical to the main thread's. Types take data-cat slots 1–8 in order and a ninth folds into Other; each node is a base disc, its wash, a hairline ring in the slot's solid and an optional glyph. Keyboard: Up and Down go round the ring of the focused node's hop distance, Right and Left step onto and along its relations, Plus expands a node with hidden neighbours, Home, End, Tab, Enter and Escape as the sheet says, with every step announced. A '+N' chip asks onExpandRequest for more; a table view shows every relation and replaces the drawing before hydration and in forced colours.
